# Game says game_over but I can still act. Let me try a move to see if the game responds.

my_pos = white[0]['boundary'][0] if white else None

# Check squares again

        cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
        center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
        center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
        squares.append((n['color'], center_r, center_c, n['pixels']))

print(f"Squares: {squares}")
</parameter>
</function>
